pages.text: Our menu includes a dedicated gluten-free menu prepared in a separate kitchen. We offer several vegan entrees every day. All chicken is certified halal. Our desserts are made without peanuts or tree nuts, and we are a peanut-free kitchen.
Went to Cedar & Salt with my celiac friend and they were super careful, gluten-free menu is legit.
We offer vegetarian options. Please note: our kitchen has cross-contact with peanuts and shellfish and we cannot guarantee allergen-free preparation.
Noodle Harbor has a great vegan tofu pho and the staff confirmed the broth is plant-based.
Burgers, fries, and shakes. Open late.
